verdict.rationale: Postmark's docs clearly define a single documented call (POST /email) with required auth header (X-Postmark-Server-Token), a test token for sandboxed sends, and official SDKs across languages; community testimonials confirm quick, minimal-code implementation ("implemented in 5 minutes", curl-only POSTs) and MessageID tracking is demonstrated in the batch example with per-recipient MessageIDs returned. missing for 10: a directly quoted minimal quickstart code snippet in the evidence pack itself (only referenced, not shown) and explicit single-send MessageID confirmation snippet.
